families.note: Search-centric mission-control Home: dominant omni-search bar is the primary verb; large editorial destination panels with title + purpose + live status; notices carry one clear action. Owned end-to-end.
Live fuzzy discovery across settings/categories/managers/destinations with deep-link jump to the owning category + setting; results restructure Home; no-results and typo-suggestion fixtures.
Book-TOC: left vertical category index + continuous document; portable scrollspy without oscillation; exposure control; prose fields. Owned end-to-end.
Full object model with all 17 provider fixtures; CLI-owned vs PM-direct OAuth boundary; requested/effective routes; Free Models wrapper; catalog freshness/last-known-good. Owned end-to-end.

Setting rows exercising all 9 value states (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not-configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective-differs), exposure levels, secret-value taxonomy, action-vs-value separation.

Shows effective instruction sources, AGENTS.md precedence chain, source hashes + lightness warnings, included/omitted blocks, persona footprint, selected vs installed tools, compaction strategy, cache compatibility, retrieval caps, context admission receipt. Registry not injected just because Settings exposes it.

Evidence-backed degrading Assistant Gists: half-life (fade not delete), verified/unverified provenance, pin, version history + restore, capsule preview/token estimate, rebuild/dedupe/summarize/archive/redact, half-life + active-context status. Automated systems use explicit retrieval, not hidden Gists.

Behavior-not-authority: mission/use boundary, model-facing capsule preview, source/version/provenance, eligible skills, requested capabilities, import diff with trust/secret/prompt-injection scan, child-only flag. Corrects stale regular/yolo coupling.

Defaults+ceilings only (Goal defaults, pause/resume/checkpoint, verification strength, sustainable fan-out, capacity reserve, worker/reviewer route classes, worktree/testing defaults). Runtime admits actual work; requested/effective worker+reviewer routes projected.

Orchestrator-owned templates with requested vs effective members + concurrency and waves; purpose, member roles, persona/capability requirements, allowed provider/account/model candidates, min/max members, adaptive sizing, usage/cost/time reserve, write/worktree policy, board topology, diversity/corroboration, reducer/synthesis, failure/stop behavior.

Ordered last-match-wins rules, per-tool overrides, per-Persona profiles, FileSafe non-bypassable floor, doom-loop threshold/action, ELI5 + Expert views, presets, read-only/full matrices, external-directory allowlist, requested/effective/origin across Global/Project/Package/Seam/Lane scope.

Off/Auto(default)/On; Auto runs only when risk/phase triggers justify; On may inspect all turns. Read-only by default, bounded deltas, cannot widen authority, cannot block primary work on its own failure. Chat may override BSD for one turn or current thread. Advanced: route, risk/phase triggers, usage guard, latency budget, privacy boundary, tool access, health.
